reviews.conclusion: Visible pause/settings visits total 3.25-4.75 s; a separate narrow game view lasts 2.0-2.5 s with unknown pause state. These provide ordinary context but do not exactly resolve -4.85 s. The sequence continues in the same portal/ocean setting.

Portal entry/exit and stronghold traversal contain four settings sequences. Visible menu duration totals approximately 2.75-4.75 s, compatible with the -3.7333 s deficit. Loading and ordinary inventory interactions are not counted as menu pauses.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
